source.act: Resolução SME nº 08, de 09 de dezembro de 2025
source.title: Dispõe sobre o processo de atribuição de classes e/ou turmas para o ano letivo de 2026 aos docentes da Secretaria Municipal de Educação de Limeira.
source.issuer: Secretaria Municipal de Educação de Limeira
source.official_journal: Jornal Oficial do Município de Limeira
annexes_materialized: Anexo I - Cronograma do processo de atribuição
source.binary_custody_reason: Direct non-portal retrieval returned access blocking; exact official PDF URL and indexed page text are proven, but no binary hash is claimed.

article_index.topic: School and SME authorities must execute and monitor the assignment process.
SME designates the commission that coordinates, executes and evaluates assignment.
Director/Vice-Director and designated commission assign classes/turmas respecting classification; includes state teachers, EJA, effective substitutes and PSS 04/2025 under Annex I chronology.

Defines available weekly teaching workloads, AEE operation, Art/Physical Education specialist workload composition, Linguagens e Tecnologias/oficinas complement and PSS 04/2025 maximum 48 h/a contract.
Preferential qualification/experience criteria for 1st-3rd year literacy classes and EJA, with residual assignment allowed if no preferred candidate remains.
Titular teachers away/designated elsewhere still participate to compose workload and assume assigned classes after the leave/designation ends.
Defines excess teachers, return/relocation rights, adido status and no pay/advantage loss from adido declaration.
Readapted titular teachers are classified but do not participate in assignment; cessation during year triggers free-class assumption or adido treatment.
Teacher unable to attend workload composition must use an adult proxy with specific authority who is not a public employee; otherwise assignment is compulsory at session end.

Defines operating duties of effective substitute EI/EF teachers, pedagogical intervention when not substituting, coverage of specialist/LT absences and prohibition on assigning free classes to effective substitutes.
Defines the sequential initial assignment process, phases, times, workload composition, specialist/LT/oficina proof requirements and PSS 04/2025 portal assignment on 15-16 Jan 2026.
Teacher is responsible for legality/compatibility when accumulating two teaching posts/jobs/functions, especially municipal HTPC rules.

Defines sequential order for assignments during school year 2026 at school and SME levels, including adidos, stable CLT, effective substitutes, supplemental workload, event substitutions and PSS 04/2025.
After initial assignment, school directors register titular teachers from other schools for substitution; external-unit supplemental workload may not exceed 66 h/a weekly total with the post.
Defines EJA substitution/new-class order: titular EJA workload, titular supplemental workload, PSS 04/2025, then exceptional item 15.20 candidates.
Special Projects require a habilitation process based on SME-defined criteria without changing list classification; short substitutions may exceptionally bypass habilitation.
Creche sectors B1/B2/M1 may be assigned as supplemental workload or to PSS 04/2025/item 15.20 candidates, prioritizing morning service; SME defines necessary staffing quantity.
Integral Education 2026 assignments occur in phase I; creche B1/B2 and APC supplemental/PSS assignments occur in Feb 2026 with counter-shift service starting Mar 2026.
Guarantees assignment possibility for continuity of support to students with disabilities in Special Projects, respecting classification and school-direction evaluation in articulation with SME.
Titular teachers may choose supplemental workload at home school or initial SME phase II; HTPC and schedule compatibility must be considered and documented.
When titular leave is extended, current substitute may continue without new assignment at administration/school discretion; director informs SME by internal communication/iDoc.
Titular teacher on supplemental workload is disconnected from substitution after 30 absence days, consecutive or interpolated, subject to enumerated exceptions; short-assignment absences accumulate.

PSS 04/2025 teacher reaches contract termination at 30 consecutive/interpolated absence days; short assignments accumulate; voluntary withdrawal allows new indication in another approved modality only after 45 days; lesson absences count toward unjustified absent day.
CLT temporary teacher in Special Projects/substitution/transitory vacancy is evaluated quarterly on student learning commitment, professional responsibility and personal performance attributes.

School direction and pedagogical coordinator perform the evaluation; persistent gaps after documented guidance lead to loss of assignment, exclusion from new project/oficina/substitution classes that year and temporary-contract termination.
PSS 01/2024 substitutes with provisional stability at contract end keep a 2026 substitution workload until stability ends, corresponding to 2025 assigned classes/turmas/periods at the same workplace.
Defines assignment-session conduct, including entry preference for teacher/legal representative, blue pen, photo ID, no food and no mobile-phone use at the assignment desk.
Teacher entering service during school year receives assignment at exercise time; simultaneous entrants are ordered by public-exam ranking.
All effective and CLT teachers, including creche/oficina/APC/Special Project assignments, are subject to SME rules for school documentation, reports and planning.

Bars new assignments for titular teachers who withdraw/are disconnected under Art.22 and, in same contract, PSS 04/2025 teachers who withdraw, are disconnected under Art.23, fail timely presentation after contract documentation or fail to complete contract documents; lists exceptions.
Bars effective or CLT teacher assignment where spouse/partner or relative up to third degree would be the teacher's supervisor.
Assignment appeals have no suspensive or retroactive effect and must be filed with SME within two business days after the motivating event.
Omitted cases go to the assignment coordination/execution/evaluation commission for school year 2026.
Resolution takes effect on publication, retroactive to 6 Dec 2025, revoking conflicting provisions.

annex_i.title: Cronograma do Processo de Atribuição de Classes e/ou Aulas

selected_schedule.events: School and SME phases for workload composition, EJA, excess teachers, adidos/stable CLT/effective substitutes.
School/SME supplemental workload assignment for Art, Physical Education, classes, LT and extracurricular workshops.
SME single phase for remaining EI/EF/EE/Art/Physical Education/LT/workshop balances as supplemental workload.
Portal indication of available substitution classes/turmas, with result stated for 26 Jan 2026 and 48 h/a weekly ceiling.

rules: Art/Physical Education specialists compose workload at their school/extensions with minimum class counts by workload.
Remaining workload may use Linguagens e Tecnologias and/or extracurricular workshops under stated qualification rules.
Titular teacher LT formation is exceptionally allowed to be proven by the first school day of 2026.

pss_48_hour_ceiling.rule: PSS 04/2025 contract may reach at most 48 h/a weekly across listed workloads/projects.

initial_portal_assignment.rule: PSS 04/2025 portal indication occurs 15-16 Jan 2026; result is stated for 26 Jan 2026; proof upload is required for LT/workshop qualification and missing proof annuls indication.

during_year_order.rule: Defines school/SME sequence for 2026 during-year assignments and substitutions.

cross_school_supplemental_ceiling.rule: Titular teacher registered at another school may receive only supplemental workload there and total post + supplemental workload may not exceed 66 h/a weekly.

disability_continuity.rule: Continuity assignment for students with disabilities in Special Projects is preserved subject to classification and school-direction evaluation with SME.

titular_absence_30_days.rule: Thirty absent days on supplemental workload disconnect the titular teacher from substitution subject to expressly listed exceptions.

pss_absence_and_withdrawal.rule: Thirty consecutive/interpolated absence days end the PSS contract; voluntary withdrawal allows another approved modality only after 45 days.

temporary_teacher_evaluation.rule: Quarterly evaluation applies to CLT temporary teachers in Special Projects/substitution/transitory vacancy; persistent documented gaps can terminate assignment and temporary contract.

new_assignment_bar.rule: Defines when titular and PSS 04/2025 teachers are barred from new assignments and enumerates exceptions.

appeals.rule: Two-business-day appeal window; no suspensive or retroactive effect.

primary_confirms: SMEOP-R06: Art. 23 30-day PSS contract termination and cumulative short-assignment absences
SMEOP-R07: Art. 23 §2 45-day wait after voluntary withdrawal before indication in another approved modality
SMEOP-R02 core consequence: Art. 30 same-contract bar after PSS withdrawal/Art.23 disconnection, while the operational page supplies the lack-of-requirement workflow trigger
remains_operational_only_unless_separate: SMEOP-R03 modality execution order on current web page

divergence.primary_publication: Art. 11 §5(b), pp.175-176: PSS 04/2025 LT/workshop proof is part of indication/upload and absence of proof annuls indication.
divergence.current_operational_page: Current SME page says LT formation may be presented to the school director during the first semester of 2026, citing Art. 11 §5(b).
